description: Itemised official government fee for a Maltese passport (Identità): age band (under 10 / 10-15 / 16+), seasonal adult rate (€70 September-March, €80 April-August), the official urgent service (€160 adult, 4 working hours, in Malta only), the €15 supplement when a lost or stolen passport was still valid, and, for applications through a Maltese embassy or consulate abroad, the mission processing fee and courier charges (flagged where unverified). Deterministic: computed from the official fee table with sources. Information only; confirm with the Passport Office or mission before paying.

age.description: Age in years of the passport holder on the application date.

location.description: "malta" if applying at the Passport Office in Malta, "abroad" if applying through a Maltese embassy, high commission or consulate.

lost_still_valid.description: True if the passport being replaced was lost, stolen or destroyed while still valid (adds the €15 oath supplement; a Maltese police report is required).

month.description: Month of application, 1-12 (adult standard fee is €80 April-August, €70 otherwise). Defaults to the current month.

urgent.description: True for the official urgent service (4 working hours in Malta; from abroad the urgent fee applies but no 4-hour timeframe).

name: estimate_malta_passport_fee

outputSchema.description: Mirabello envelope; tool fields vary; error only on failure.

title: Maltese Passport Fee Estimate
